lines: By the week, not the night. Nobody stays in Aureline for one night.
Sixteen beds in the common room and every one of them spoken for by dusk.
If you are only passing through, say so, and I will not sell you a week.
Do not move the chess. He comes back Thursdays.
He has come back every Thursday for two years and he has never once won.
Brought sixty head up the central road and I will not do it again in summer.
Four days of walking and you can see the city on the second one.
That is what nobody tells you. You can see it for two whole days before you get there.
I work at the Foundation and I lodge in a common room. Both of those are true.
It is a good employer and this is an expensive city and there it is.
Do not let anybody tell you the people in that building are getting rich.
Paid off out of a deep-water hull and it never went to sea.
Full year's wages to sit at a mooring. I asked why once.
The owner said it was chartered. Would not say by whom. Paid me in Foundation notes.
Eleven years in that bed by the wall. It is not sad. It is simply where I live.
Read the board by the door. Some of those notes are older than my stay.
Nobody takes them down because taking one down would mean deciding something.
